app_context: Mobile-first business calculator for import pricing (India/China to South Africa). Clean, professional, SaaS aesthetic. High data density requiring excellent readability.

typography.monospace: JetBrains Mono (for supplier codes, generated IDs, pricing outputs, and exchange rates)
rules: CRITICAL: Do not use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Hierarchy Gap: Jump between heading and subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
Data Highlights: For the 'Total Landed Cost' and 'Cost Per Meter', use text-4xl to text-5xl, tracking-tighter, font-mono.
Overlines/Labels: Must be uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em] (tracking-widest).
No full-screen gradients. Use solid colors or very subtle noise textures.
Final calculated prices (ZAR) MUST use the 'success' green to indicate positive output value and draw the eye.
Hover states must explicitly set text color (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).
Avoid completely transparent backgrounds. Ensure elements have a solid or frosted (glassmorphism) background.

surfaces_and_visuals.cards: Subtle roundness (rounded-[8px]), 1px border (border-slate-200), flat or very soft shadow (shadow-sm). Do not overuse cards.
surfaces_and_visuals.header_nav: Sticky glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200). DO NOT use purely transparent headers over scrollable content.
surfaces_and_visuals.inputs: Use standard Shadcn Input styles, slightly thicker borders on focus (ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-1).
surfaces_and_visuals.interactive: Flat with crisp edges. On hover: -translate-y-[1px] and shadow-md.

layouts.mobile_first: Start with grid-cols-1. Ensure inputs and buttons are at least 44px tall for tap targets (mobile usability).
layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid style: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 or gap-6. Highlight the most recent calculation metrics in a span-2 or full-width top card.
layouts.forms: Use Shadcn Form/Input components. Labels left-aligned. Use gap-6 between form fields to avoid crowding.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: p-6 or p-8 inside structural cards. Use py-12 between major sections.
layouts.tables: Configuration tabs heavily rely on tables. Ensure tables are wrapped in overflow-x-auto for mobile. Use simple borders (border-b) rather than full grid lines for a cleaner look.

components.libraries: Shadcn/UI (adapted for .js files), lucide-react for icons, react-hook-form.
customization: Tabs: Use Shadcn Tabs for navigating [Dashboard, Calculate, Configuration]. Override fixed heights (h-9 to h-auto) for better mobile wrapping.
Dropdowns/Selects: Use Shadcn Select. Must NOT have transparent backgrounds.
Buttons: Pill-shaped or max 8px rounded corners. Primary actions should stand out visually.
Data Display: Use small 'Stat Cards' for Exchange Rates (INR->ZAR, CNY->ZAR).

rules: CRITICAL: Do NOT use 'transition: all'. It breaks transforms. Use 'transition-colors', 'transition-opacity', or 'transition-transform'.
Micro-interactions: Hover states on list items, slight scale-up on primary buttons.
Staggered entrance: Fade-in history list items using simple opacity/translate keyframes or framer-motion if installed.
CRITICAL: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='calculate-submit-btn', data-testid='config-tab-btn').
Maintain WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 for normal text).
Focus states must be highly visible.
Labels must be associated with inputs (htmlFor).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply generic centered layouts (.App { text-align: center; }). Keep text left-aligned.
This is a 'Pure frontend' app. ALL data must be saved to and retrieved from browser localStorage.
Pre-fill the Configuration context/localStorage with realistic editable placeholder values (e.g., Sea Freight India->SA: R 500/kg, Air Freight: R 1500/kg, Customs Duty: 20%).
Auto-derive the cost tier logic based on weight and standard shipping cost formulas.
No AI emojis. Use lucide-react for all iconography.
Create a reliable unique supplier code generator logic (e.g., 'LI' + Date/Random numbers).
CRITICAL: File extensions must be .jsx or .js. DO NOT use .tsx or .ts for this React app unless the environment explicitly enforces TypeScript (user specified js).
Prioritize responsive design: Ensure the Landed Cost Calculator output is extremely clear and fixed at the bottom or highly prominent on mobile screens.
